title: The DFT and the radix-2 FFT
summary: Write the discrete Fourier transform as a direct sum, the recursive radix-2 fast Fourier transform, and the inverse transform.

mutants.dft_positive_exponent: Uses +i in the exponent, which gives the spectrum of the reversed signal.
mutants.fft_no_twiddle: Leaves out the twiddle factors in the combination step.
mutants.ifft_no_scale: Does not divide by n in the inverse transform.
mutants.fft_halves_swapped: Puts even minus twiddle in the first half and even plus twiddle in the second half.
mutants.fft_no_length_check: Does not check the length, so a length that is not a power of 2 gives a wrong result.
